heroSummary: Granite School District students start Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and the last student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. The calendar includes 176 student days. Parent-teacher conference dates vary by school level, with no school September 18 and February 12 for conference compensation days. High schools also use a separate A/B calendar.
calendarNotes: Granite School District students begin August 12, with kindergarten testing shown August 12–14 and kindergarten early out August 17–21. The approved calendar lists 176 student days and divides them across four terms of 45, 40, 45, and 46 days. Senior high, junior high, and elementary SEP conferences use different dates in September and February. September 18 and February 12 are compensatory no-school days after those conference clusters. Fall Break is October 15–16, Winter Break is December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is March 29–April 2. Additional no-school and teacher contract days extend several breaks and term transitions during the year. The final student day and fourth-term ending are Wednesday, May 26, with the calendar marking an elementary planning/early-dismissal schedule.

customSections.label: What Granite's Friday Labels Mean
customSections.content: The approved PDF defines P as a planning day with early dismissal for elementary schools. Granite's live 2026–27 calendar also describes routine Fridays as early-out/planning days for elementary and junior high schools, while selected term-ending or conference dates are elementary only. Because the two official sources use different wording, junior high families should confirm Friday dismissal times with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Granite School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day is Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The calendar also labels August 12–14 for kindergarten testing.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 15–16, 2026. Students are also off October 19–20 and return Wednesday, October 21.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students remain out January 4 for a teacher contract day and return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29, through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students also have no school Monday, April 5 and return Tuesday, April 6.

Fall dates are September 14–15 for senior high, September 16–17 for junior high, and September 15–16 for elementary SEP conferences. Winter dates are February 9–10, February 8–9, and February 10–11 respectively.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Granite publish a 2026–27 A/B calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Granite's official calendar page links a separate high-school A/B calendar. Use it with the student's school schedule; the MySchoolDates ICS file does not repeat the daily rotation.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Granite School District's last day of school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. The approved PDF marks an elementary planning/early-dismissal schedule, while Granite's live calendar currently lists only the last day of school. Elementary families should confirm dismissal time with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in Granite's 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved calendar lists 176 student days: 45 in Term 1, 40 in Term 2, 45 in Term 3, and 46 in Term 4.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 10, 2026, against Granite School District's live calendar page and a visually rendered copy of both pages of the complete approved 2026–27 calendar updated June 2, 2026.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the approved Granite calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The source is a two-page Granite School District calendar marked approved by the Board February 4, 2025 and updated/approved June 2, 2026.
Both pages were rendered and checked visually because shaded date bars, P planning markers, conference labels, term boundaries, and calendar codes do not survive plain-text extraction reliably.
The four official term counts sum to the printed total of 176 student days.
Granite's official calendar page links the same 2026-27 approved PDF, a separate 2026-27 A/B calendar, and a separate 2027 graduation-dates PDF.

The approved PDF's P legend says elementary-only early dismissal, while the live calendar also names junior high on routine Fridays; this difference is disclosed and junior-high families are directed to the school bell schedule.

The approved PDF marks an elementary planning/early-dismissal schedule on May 26, while Granite's live calendar currently lists only the last day of school; elementary families are directed to confirm dismissal time with their school.
The supplied Counselors-2026-calendar.pdf was rendered and checked but excluded because it is explicitly a 199-day counselor employee calendar, not the student school-year calendar.
Recurring Friday planning schedules and daily high-school A/B letters are summarized rather than exported as dozens of standalone events.
The .ics file is a one-time import and does not update automatically if Granite revises a date or rotation.
